notice: The land around AD 1 for Grind Strat, 1 km grid, and how it changes to 1219: forest shares estimated from pollen (about 250 BC to AD 250), which places were forest and when they changed placed by a rule. meta.encoding: (band << 3) | the AD 1 class per cell; 0 = the same at AD 1 as in 1219

anchor.note: Forest and conifer shares from pollen window 6; AD 1 is the middle of the window.

labels.forestShare: Forest share: estimated from pollen (REVEALS; 1 degree cells; gaps filled by a statistical model) for about 250 BC to AD 250
labels.forestEdges: Which places were forest at AD 1, and in which year before 1219 they changed: placed by a rule (the 1219 rule), not a historical map
labels.quality: Squares east of 28E (Belarus, north-west Russia, Ukraine) are marked model-filled, lower quality: the paper finds its map of remote north-eastern and south-eastern Europe, where it has no pollen-based (REVEALS) estimates, of considerably lower quality, and leaves out the squares that are too uncertain (confidence region over 9); none of this map's land squares were left out. The 28E line is our own reading, not the paper's (Githumbi et al. 2022, section 4.1; TO CHECK).
